nodes.text: Life.me is a personal timeline application that traces users' phone activity by capturing events happening around them. It's like a personal secretary that helps users bring up their memories in an effortless, smart and fun way.

My responsibilities to this project was interaction design. I also worked as a design lead in a cross-functional team with visual and motion designers, user researchers, prototypers, project managers and developers.
Timeline view in Day, Month, and Year
The timeline view spans Day, Month, and Year, surfacing diary-like moments so users can quickly look back on their day.
Tapping in reveals a summary of activity recorded by month or by year.
Beyond the data and records, Life.me can automatically pick a video theme and generate a look-back video for users to share on social media.
